title: Troubleshooting Gurgling Drains: The Vent Stack Connection
description: When fixture drains gurgle or smell like sewer gas, the issue often originates in the venting system rather than the drain line itself. Plumbing vents equalize air pressure within the drainage network, allowing wastewater to flow smoothly. When a vent stack becomes obstructed by debris or improper installation, discharging water creates a vacuum. This negative pressure pulls water out of adjacent P-traps, breaking the hydraulic seal and letting sewer gas escape into the building. Identifying gurgling sounds early allows plumbers to clear vent blockages before traps dry out completely or drains back up into living spaces.
